class.name: Toast
class.brief_description: A transient message overlay, fading in near the bottom of the screen.
class.description:
Toast shows a short message that appears near the bottom of the screen and fades out automatically. Create a default text toast with [method make_text] (or [method Context.make_toast]) and display it with [method Context.show_toast] / [method Activity.show_toast]. [ActivityManager] queues toasts (FIFO by default), animates the fade-in/out, and frees the node when done.
A custom layout is authored as a scene whose root extends Toast and overrides [method _on_create] to build its UI — exactly like [Dialog]. The old [code]custom_scene[/code] indirection has been removed.
Toast is a C++ "is-a IContext" via the [code]ContextBase<Toast>[/code] CRTP mixin — at the C++ level it [i]is[/i] a Context. Like [Activity] / [Dialog] it auto-bootstraps for preview (F6) on [code]NOTIFICATION_READY[/code] via [method run_standalone_bootstrap]: when no [Application] is bound (i.e. it is the entry scene, not shown via [method Context.show_toast]) and not in the editor, it spawns a [StandaloneApplication] and dispatches [method _on_create]. Override [method _on_setup_standalone] to register mock services first.
Each Toast has an optional lifecycle owner (set by [ActivityManager]). When the owning [Activity] is destroyed, its pending toasts are cancelled.

method.name: _on_create
method.description: Called once when the Toast is shown. Override in a custom Toast scene to build the UI; if not overridden, a default panel+label using [member text] is built. [param saved_state] receives [member Intent.extras] when present.

method.name: _on_dismiss
method.description: Called when the Toast is being dismissed (after its display duration, or via [method dismiss]). Clean up here.

method.name: _on_setup_standalone
method.description: Called only on the Run-As-Standalone preview path, right after the host [Application] is built but before [method _on_create]. Override to register mock services / preset Intent extras. Not called when shown via [method Context.show_toast].

method.name: dismiss
method.description: Dismisses this Toast (triggers [method _on_dismiss] then frees it). When previewing standalone, dismissing the root Toast quits the SceneTree.

method.name: get_application
method.description: Returns the [Application] hosting this Toast, or [code]null[/code] before it has been shown.

method.name: get_context
method.description: Returns the [Context] (the hosting [Application]) for this Toast.

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns how long the Toast stays on screen (in seconds), excluding fade-in and fade-out.

method.name: get_lifecycle_owner
method.description: Returns the lifecycle owner, or [code]null[/code] if unassigned or already destroyed.

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the message text of this Toast.

method.name: is_owned_by
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this Toast's lifecycle owner has the given object id (used by [ActivityManager] to cancel an owner's pending toasts).

method.name: is_standalone
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if hosted by a [StandaloneApplication] (self-hosted preview), [code]false[/code] when shown by a normal [ActivityManager].

method.name: make_text
method.description: Creates a new default text Toast node (not yet in any tree). Equivalent to [code]Context.make_toast(text, duration)[/code]. Pass it to [method Context.show_toast]. [codeblock] show_toast(Toast.make_text("Hello World", 3.0)) [/codeblock]

method.name: run_standalone_bootstrap
method.description: Builds the standalone host ([StandaloneApplication] + StandaloneRoot), reparents this Toast under it, and dispatches [method _on_create]. Normally invoked from [code]_notification(NOTIFICATION_READY)[/code] via [code]call_deferred[/code]; exposed for tests. Self-guards: no-op if an [Application] is already bound or running in the editor.

method.name: set_duration
method.description: Sets how long the Toast stays on screen (in seconds).

method.name: set_lifecycle_owner
method.description: Sets the lifecycle owner. Set by [ActivityManager]; manual use is not normally needed.

method.name: set_text
method.description: Sets the message text of this Toast.

members.member: The message text to display (used by the default visual).
Optional enter [Transition] played in standalone preview.
